rules.name: No orphan canonical rows
rules.description: Canonical, classification, credit and membership rows must not have broken foreign keys.
rules.remediation: Repair the normalization or migration that produced the orphan row.

rules.name: Canonical provenance is mandatory
rules.description: Every canonical entity, credit, classification and aggregate must reference a source record.
rules.remediation: Re-run normalization with a complete raw-response cache.

rules.name: MBIDs are canonical UUIDs
rules.description: Every external MBID used by canonical entities must be a valid UUID.
rules.remediation: Quarantine or correct the source record in the normalization input.

rules.name: Canonical MBIDs are unique
rules.description: Artist, album, release and recording tables must not contain duplicate MBIDs.
rules.remediation: Resolve the identity conflict in E4 with deterministic evidence.

rules.name: Classification labels are taxonomy leaves
rules.description: Every album and band classification must reference an assignable taxonomy leaf.
rules.remediation: Correct the classification or taxonomy version.

rules.name: Taxonomy versions align
rules.description: Classifications and aggregates must use a persisted taxonomy version.
rules.remediation: Rebuild classifications for the active taxonomy version.

rules.name: Every canonical album has a primary classification
rules.description: Each canonical album must have one primary leaf or an explicit approved exception.
rules.expected: 0 unexcepted albums without a primary label
rules.remediation: Classify the album or register a reviewed quarantine exception.

rules.name: Album classification review is visible
rules.description: Medium-confidence album classifications must be visible in the exception/review registry.
rules.remediation: Review the album or record an approved exception.

rules.name: One primary album classification
rules.description: A canonical album must have at most one primary label per taxonomy version.
rules.remediation: Resolve the classification conflict in E4.

rules.name: Band aggregate review is visible
rules.description: Review or low-confidence band aggregates must be visible in the exception registry.
rules.remediation: Review the aggregate or record an approved exception.

rules.name: One primary band aggregate
rules.description: An artist must have at most one primary aggregate per taxonomy version.
rules.remediation: Rebuild the aggregate projection in E4.

rules.name: Credit scope and targets are consistent
rules.description: Credit scope must match its release-group, release and recording targets.
rules.remediation: Correct credit context in E4.

rules.name: Dataset membership is consistent
rules.description: Membership lifecycle and active seed bands must be consistent with the selected dataset.
rules.remediation: Re-run membership synchronization.

rules.name: Normalization run metadata aligns
rules.description: The selected normalization run must be complete and match dataset, taxonomy and seed-list versions.
rules.remediation: Select the correct completed normalization run.

rules.name: Canonical provenance completeness
rules.description: Measures the proportion of canonical rows with provenance.
rules.remediation: Advisory metric; structural provenance rule is blocking.

rules.name: Album date completeness
rules.description: Measures albums with a first release date and date precision.
rules.remediation: Advisory metric; report source gaps.

rules.name: Band metadata completeness
rules.description: Measures seed bands with country and Wikidata QID.
rules.remediation: Advisory metric; report missing metadata.

rules.name: Producer coverage
rules.description: Measures albums and bands with producer or co-producer credits.
rules.remediation: Advisory metric; missing credits are not negative evidence.

rules.name: Coverage by analysis dimension
rules.description: Reports coverage by band, decade, taxonomy leaf, role, scope, country, source and batch.
rules.remediation: Advisory metric; use denominators in analysis.

rules.name: Missing data visibility
rules.description: Missing values are reported explicitly and are not treated as negative evidence.
rules.remediation: Keep the interpretation warning in every report.
